name: ERQA
intro: ERQA（Embodied Reasoning Question Answering）是 Google DeepMind 随 Gemini Robotics 发布的开放具身推理基准。它包含 400 道图文交错的四选一 VQA，覆盖空间、轨迹、动作、状态估计、指向、多视角和任务推理；其中 28% 使用多张图像。
build_method: 具身能力分类, 披露图像来源, 400题全部人工标注与质检, TFRecord公开发布
eval_feature: 八类具身推理, 28%多图题, TFRecord固定直接回答后缀, 论文CoT追加, 完整响应精确匹配
scale: 400个问题（84空间、72动作、66轨迹、55状态、38任务、37多视角、34指向、14其他）
build_method_en: Embodied-capability taxonomy, disclosed image sources, manual labeling and QA of all 400 items, public TFRecord release
eval_feature_en: Eight embodied-reasoning categories, 28% multi-image, fixed TFRecord direct suffix, paper CoT append, full-response exact match
intro_en: ERQA (Embodied Reasoning Question Answering) is an open embodied-reasoning benchmark released by Google DeepMind with Gemini Robotics. It contains 400 interleaved image-text four-choice VQA items spanning spatial, trajectory, action, state-estimation, pointing, multi-view, and task reasoning; 28% use multiple images.
scale_en: 400 questions (84 spatial, 72 action, 66 trajectory, 55 state, 38 task, 37 multi-view, 34 pointing, 14 other)

drawio_review_note: Aligned with Gemini Robotics report arXiv:2503.20020v1 and official ERQA repository 5bba488. The fixed TFRecord has SHA256 1974f5e5…, 91,402,921 bytes, and 400/400 questions ending with the exact suffix ‘Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.’ The paper without-CoT condition uses that original question; its optional CoT instruction is appended exactly, and no extra direct prompt is invented. Release code uses temperature 0 with OpenAI max_tokens=300 and Gemini max_output_tokens=500. It normalizes the full response by removing periods, trimming whitespace, lowercasing, and then exact matching the ground truth; the normalized full response itself is scored. Image selection and question-authoring details remain undisclosed.
